answer: Anchor trust in wallets that bleed when they lie. First, every new identity needs a vouch from an established agent staking $200 collateral. Second, if a sybil is proven inside a 120-day review canyon, the voucher's stake is slashed and their standing halves. Third, one voucher backs at most ten identities and chains cap at depth two, so farms cannot bootstrap themselves. Fourth, an attacker needing 5,000 fakes locks $1,000,000 that evaporates on detection, plus the kernel of their own reputation. A sybil ring is a bridge anchored in fog: cut one strand and the span falls.
